International non-proprietary name (INN): adjuvanted inactivated vaccine against Ornithobacterium rhinotracheale serotype A
Active substance: inactivated whole cell suspension of Ornithobacterium rhinotracheale serotype A, strain B3263/91
Therapeutic indication: For passive immunisation of broilers induced by active immunisation of female broiler breeders to reduce infection with Ornithobacterium rhinotracheale serotype A when this agent is involved. Under field conditions passive immunity is transferred during lay for 43 weeks after the last vaccination of broiler breeders, resulting in a duration of passive immunity in broilers of at least 14 days after hatching.
